description: dev-kit routing: one decision per task. A multi-area build starts dev-kit:plan on its own (repo edits held until a plan is approved or the user says to edit directly); a bug starts dev-kit:investigate on its own (edits held until it has run or the user says to fix it directly); direct edits that reach a second area are held the same way. DEV_KIT_ROUTING=off|nudge|gate (default gate).
